# peernode_storage_access_key (Resource)

An S3 access key for `s3` buckets. The secret is available only when the key is created and is stored in the Terraform state, so protect the state. Change `keepers` to rotate the key (a new key is created and the old one revoked). Destroying the resource revokes the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peernode_storage_bucket" "assets" {
  name = "acme-assets"
}

# A key limited to one bucket. Change keepers to rotate it.
resource "peernode_storage_access_key" "ci" {
  name    = "ci deploy"
  bucket  = peernode_storage_bucket.assets.name
  keepers = { rotated = "2026-12" }
}

# The official AWS provider manages objects through the PeerNode S3 endpoint. Terraform cannot configure a
# provider from resources that do not exist yet, so create the key first:
#   terraform apply -target=peernode_storage_access_key.ci && terraform apply
# (or keep the bucket and key in a separate configuration and pass the key in as variables).
provider "aws" {
  alias                       = "peernode"
  region                      = peernode_storage_access_key.ci.region
  access_key                  = peernode_storage_access_key.ci.access_key_id
  secret_key                  = peernode_storage_access_key.ci.secret_access_key
  s3_use_path_style           = true
  skip_credentials_validation = true
  skip_requesting_account_id  = true
  skip_metadata_api_check     = true
  skip_region_validation      = true
  endpoints {
    s3 = peernode_storage_access_key.ci.endpoint
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_object" "index" {
  provider     = aws.peernode
  bucket       = peernode_storage_bucket.assets.name
  key          = "index.html"
  content      = "<h1>Hello</h1>"
  content_type = "text/html"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) Limit the key to this `s3` bucket. Empty: every `s3` bucket of the account.
- `keepers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; changing any of them replaces the key (rotation).
- `name` (String) A name to recognise the key.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Allow only reads and listings.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String) The S3 access key ID (`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`).
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint URL.
- `id` (String) Key ID (not the access key ID).
- `region` (String) Region to configure in S3 clients.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) The S3 secret access key (`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`).
